errors.text: The proposed intervention omits spark plasma sintering at 1000 °C and instead vaguely proposes introducing an alloy with B2/L21 precipitates.
No specific alloy composition, processing route, or controllable treatment is defined, so the intervention is not reproducible.
The cited evidence concerns precipitation-strengthened ferritic alloys and does not substantiate improved corrosion or oxidation resistance.
The falsification experiment lacks quantitative endpoints, exposure conditions, predicted effect sizes, and explicit rejection criteria.
